core::rva::variable_find.notes: Static evidence-only counterpart for Windows variable_find (game_layout.hpp: pinned, never called). Native lookup returns a value pointer or fallback pointer, not the Windows entry iterator. Exported prologue, caller rel32 and table/value-selection instructions establish the pin role; callable ABI compatibility and runtime integration are not established.
